Welcome to /v/GameReferrals. I've started this sub as a place to let people share game referral codes with fellow gamers free from the usual oppression and shunning one receives from doing so.

A lot of online games provide great rewards for players both new and current by simply having another player clicking a link or entering a code on a website. However most online forums and subs frown upon users sharing these as they are seen as an unfair advantage or reward or they have their own preferences as to who should be allowed to share them, such as only amongst friends.

Well I don't care about peoples feelz when it comes to game referrals. I see them as a way to encourage people to play our favorite games and as a way for new players to make contact with existing players.

If your favorite game sub or forum doesn't allow posting of your referral links you are welcome to share and request them here. Even if they do allow it post them anyway.

How can I find a friend to code with? Like preferably around my area. Just someone I can get together with and code. Where can I find a programming friend?

You can often find "users groups" and other meetups for various programming languages, OSes, and technologies. Meetup.com is a decent place to start. Or trying searching for "programming meetup <city>" and similar. If you want, tell us what languages you like and where you are... maybe someone here can point you in the right direction.

Another good place to look is at local hackerspaces, if there are any in the author's area. These tend to focus more on hardware than pure software projects, but you'll find people knowledgable in both those areas and more. The few hackerspaces I've visited have been wonderfully collaborative and friendly.
